2317-5256-5478-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

643-1477-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-1477-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Repeat from step 3.

5078-6918-6968-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-2301-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

907-2167-4548-5721.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{B} (but see notes).
907-2167-4548-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing each land you control, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{B}.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, milling three cards and returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {1}{G}.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat
907-2167-4548-5721.notes: Each legendary creature you control reduces the amount of mana required by {1}, up to a maximum of {3}. Each loop also has a chance to generate more mana than the one before it due to additional milled lands, so if you have excess mana you can begin the loop without the required number of lands and have a chance to achieve the infinite loop through milling.

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.

Repeat.

When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

It is not your turn.

Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.

Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.

4094-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.

Resolve all Conclave Sledge-Captain triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours, and causing it to gain the printed abilities three times until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Sage of Hours, triggering its abilities granted by Conclave Sledge-Captain three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours for each damage it dealt.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least three extra turns after this one.

Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.

57-1651-3459-3685-4497.description:

Activate the Slobad token by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Battered Golem.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger, destroying target permanent.
Resolve the Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Battered Golem and Spine of Ish Sah, untapping the Slobad token.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
